input: This is a synthetic workshop roleplay, not real field evidence. I want to investigate study-session scheduling for my campus club. Yesterday I personally observed our organizer chasing availability answers in the group chat; two planned study sessions were missed. I want to work through discovery before deciding what, if anything, to build.
output:
**Established:** This is a synthetic workshop roleplay (noted, will stay labeled that way). The idea is a scheduling tool for study-session coordination in your campus club; the origin is your own direct observation yesterday of the organizer chasing availability answers in the group chat, with two planned sessions missed.

**Still unknown:** what actually happened as a consequence of those two missed sessions, whether "chasing availability" was something you watched happen live or something the organizer told you about afterward, how big the club is, what reachable subset you could contact before judging, and what people currently use (if anything) besides the group chat to sort out availability.

A few questions to pin down before we count anything:

1. When you say you "personally observed" this — did you literally watch the group chat messages go back and forth in real time, or did someone (the organizer) recap it to you after the fact? I want to log this correctly as direct observation vs. secondhand report.
2. What actually happened when the two sessions got missed — did people show up to an empty room, did the organizer cancel outright, did it just fizzle with no clear resolution?
3. Roughly how many members are in the club, and how many of them could you realistically message or survey before a hackathon judging deadline?
4. Besides the group chat, is there any other tool or habit anyone uses to nail down availability (a poll app, shared calendar, spreadsheet, sign-up sheet)?
5. Since this is a synthetic exercise — do you want the "organizer chasing availability" scenario to be the one data point we track through the count ledger, or will you be inventing additional synthetic club members/responses as we go?
